description: Publish several .md files in one call (bulk upload). Requires an API key with documents:write. The outer resultCode is 200 even if some files failed — check data.succeeded and each entry in data.results.

filePaths.description: Paths to .md files on the MCP server host. Each becomes its own document.

groupId.description: File every document in this group instead of the default group.

password.description: Readers must supply this password to see the content.

viewerStyle.description: Viewer theme: readable (default), github, minimal, report, pamphlet or dark. Unknown values fall back to readable.

name: postmd_create_documents_from_files
